title: Prime Minister Takaichi Sets National Goal of 10 Million AI Robots as Japan Faces "Laps Behind" Crisis
key_facts: BigGo Finance describes a 15 Sep 2026 'GMO Conference Autumn: Physical AI 2026' in Tokyo
Speakers named: GMO Internet Group founder Masatoshi Kumagai, PM Sanae Takaichi, Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama, Hisashi Matsumoto
Kumagai said Japan is 'laps behind' in AI and robotics over the past three years and ten months
He argued Japan still has strengths in motors, precision machinery and components, and faces a shrinking workforce
The text quoted in the article contains no 10 million robot target and no Takaichi quote
quote_evidence: In AI and robotics, Japan is laps behind—and that's putting it kindly.
Japan must also establish a domestic humanoid industry and become a country capable of supplying the world.
why_it_matters_hint: Mostly an industry founder's warning at a conference; the headline's national goal of 10 million robots is not supported by the text.
notes: HEADLINE OVERSTATED: the article never states a 10 million robot goal or what Takaichi said; most of it is Kumagai's speech plus investment commentary. Event is from 15 Sep. Score cut 2.
